name: Saint / ZEE wide-shell press-fit bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer average 73 g for the exact SM-BB71-41C HOLLOWTECH II press-fit bottom-bracket assembly. The specification table lists 104.5 mm and 107 mm shell-width options without selecting one weighed width. Saint and ZEE range charts explicitly associate this C version with FC-M825 / FC-M645 respectively.
